findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Token Logging
 * @description Logging OAuth tokens can lead to credential leakage.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/token-logging
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

module TokenLoggingConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source = API::moduleImport("requests_oauthlib").getMember("OAuth2Session").getReturn().getMember(["fetch_token", "refresh_token"]).getACall()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["info", "warning", "error", "debug", "critical"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(_)
    )
    or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::builtin("print").getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(_)
    )
  }
}

module TokenLoggingFlow = TaintTracking::Global<TokenLoggingConfig>;
import TokenLoggingFlow::PathGraph

from TokenLoggingFlow::PathNode source, TokenLoggingFlow::PathNode sink
where TokenLoggingFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential token logging from $@.", source.getNode(), "token source"
findings.hypothesis: OAuth tokens might be logged or printed, leading to credential leakage.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Sensitive Data Logging
 * @description Logging variables with sensitive names (token, secret, password) can leak credentials.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/sensitive-logging
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ArgumentNode arg
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["info", "warning", "error", "debug", "critical", "log"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember("Logger").getReturn().getMember(["info", "warning", "error", "debug", "critical", "log"]).getACall()
  ) and
  arg = call.getArg(_) and
  exists(string name |
    name = arg.getALocalSource().asExpr().(Name).getId() and
    (
      name.matches("%token%") or
      name.matches("%secret%") or
      name.matches("%password%") or
      name.matches("%key%")
    ) and
    not name.matches("%public%")
  )
select call, "Logging of potentially sensitive variable '" + arg.getALocalSource().asExpr().(Name).getId() + "'."
